final: Return one JSON object with keys "disposition" and "facts". Disposition is understood, completed, clarify, or escalate. For facts, include the requested fields. For clarify or escalate include subject and reason. Use exact values from observations. If no observation applies, use an appropriate reason from date_range_required, conflicting_instructions, delivery_scope_required, permission_denied, approval_declined. For request summaries use objective review or current_status, constraint read_only or deferred, and a Boolean needs_tool.
policy: Use IDs from the request or earlier observations. A draft changes only the review queue. Publishing requires an external user's approval for the exact draft. State what you verified. If required information is missing, ask for it. Escalate a permission denial or declined approval. A failed primary read may be recovered from another permitted source. An external user update overrides the original scope. Never repeat a successful draft or publication.

archive.description: Read the historical classification using the public reference.

audit_read.description: Cross-check the primary audit endpoint (id) and the partner audit endpoint (peer_id).

check_policy.description: Read the rules and permission for the identified record. Follow linked_id within this service. An audit_id is an endpoint for the cross-check. This does not grant approval.

commit.description: Publish the draft using an approval from the external user for that draft.

inspect_partner.description: Read the linked partner or dependency record. Follow linked_id within this service. An audit_id is an endpoint for the cross-check.

lookup.description: Find the internal record ID for a public reference. The kind can tell you which service owns it.

read_backup.description: Read a backup record by ID after the primary declines or becomes stale.

read_record.description: Read a primary record by ID. Continue a primary chain through linked_id. A policy_id belongs to the policy service, a partner_id to the partner service, and an audit_primary_id to the audit service.

request_confirmation.description: Ask the external user to confirm the exact existing draft. It may decline.

stage.description: Save a reviewable draft. Send the verified assessment and exact action for the original public reference.

status.description: Get current status using the public reference.

status_mirror.description: Read current status from the independent status service using a public reference.

verify_delivery.description: Read the persisted delivery by audit reference.

verify_draft.description: Verify that a draft is still present in the review queue.

tracks.A: Choose your next action, clarification, escalation, or final answer using available observations. Use the tools yourself when the task requires them.
tracks.P: Before invoking tools, emit one JSON object with goal, subgoals, actions, success_conditions, and stop_conditions. For goal use subject and choose an objective from review, current_status, status_and_history, record_classification, verified_status, verified_assessment, or verified_delivery. Each action has id, tool, arguments, depends_on, and preconditions. For an argument from an earlier action use {"from":"action-id","field":"tool-output-field"}. Use external_event.revised_reference for a scope update. To derive an assessment from observed_metric and the supplied policy, add "evaluate":"policy_assessment" to that reference. Anticipate conditional paths in preconditions. Then act using the available tools and observations.
